targetTest: one approval of the push alone does not let the line run: it is denied again, the push approval stays unconsumed and the publish request is named again
expected: with only the git.push request approved, the line true; git push origin main && npm publish is denied again and the push approval stays unconsumed
actual: the attended hook printed nothing for the line, so it was allowed with one approval: the assertion 'the line ran with one approval' failed
semanticAssessment: The target ran after the first test (the line denied with one request, the old behaviour) and failed on its own assertion that the line was denied with only the push approved: the hook allowed it, spending the single git.push approval for the whole line, which is CR-04. Not a load, fixture or parse fault: the sibling tests of the file ran and the first test failed on its request count of 1 against the planned 2.
